title: Easy Stopwatch
description: This project adds a clean stopwatch HUD for Fabric with commands, keybinds, laps, and Mod Menu configuration. It is useful for timing runs, challenges, and in-game tasks.
body:
Stopwatch adds a simple HUD stopwatch for Fabric. It can start, stop, pause, resume, clear, toggle visibility, and save lap times.

Commands:

```text
/stopwatch start
/stopwatch stop
/stopwatch pause
/stopwatch resume
/stopwatch clear
/stopwatch lap
/toggle
/lap
/clear
```

Keybinds are available in Minecraft’s Controls menu under `Stopwatch` and are unbound by default.

Requires Fabric API and Cloth Config. Mod Menu is optional for configuration.
